reports.title: Gross National Income Inventory (ESA 2010), 2010, The Netherlands
reports.description: Extended methodological description of sources and methods for Dutch national accounts under ESA 2010, prepared for Eurostat's GNI verification process; covers the production, expenditure and income approaches with process tables.

entries.covers: Next full update of the Netherlands GNI Inventory (successor to the 2021-reporting-year inventory published 16 July 2025)

release_schedule.rule: Per Council Regulation (EU, Euratom) governing GNI harmonisation for own-resources purposes (as summarized by Eurostat): "Member States shall transmit the GNI Inventory to the Commission (Eurostat) by 31 December 2021. Subsequent updates of the GNI Inventory shall be made and transmitted to the Commission (Eurostat) within 12 months after any major change of sources or methods for compiling GNI. In any case, the GNI Inventory shall be updated at least every 5 years."
release_schedule.note: This specific report is the 2010-reporting-year edition of CBS's GNI Inventory (a benchmark-revision snapshot published March 2017); it will not itself be reissued, but CBS publishes updated GNI Inventory editions as part of the same recurring series (1995 ed. published 2016, 2010 ed. published 2017, 2015 ed. published 2021, 2021 ed. published 2025). Observed gaps between successive editions have been ~4-5 years, consistent with the EU regulatory minimum of updating at least every 5 years (or within 12 months of a major methods change). Next edition's exact date is not yet announced by CBS/Eurostat; computed date is an estimate based on the 5-year rule applied to the most recent (2021) edition's July 2025 publication, and the ~4-year historical cadence.

reports.title: Structural Business Statistics (SBS) / Production Statistics
reports.description: Annual survey-based statistics on enterprises, coordinated on the Statistical Business Register; the primary source for output, intermediate consumption and value added in the Dutch production approach to GDP.

release_schedule.rule: The survey operates on an annual basis. Usually, definite figures become available 18 months after the year under review.
release_schedule.note: CBS's 'Production statistics' (Productiestatistiek) survey description page states annual periodicity and that definite figures are 'usually' available 18 months after the year under review, but gives no exact day/month. Reference year 2024 definite figures would fall due around mid-2026 (already passed as of 2026-08-11), so the next occurrence computed here is for reference year 2025, expected around Q2 2027 (18 months after 2025-12-31). No dated release calendar entry for this specific survey was found on CBS's general publication calendar (cbs.nl/en-gb/publication-calendar) or Dutch publicatieplanning search.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position
reports.description: Dutch balance-of-payments and IIP statistics, compiled by the central bank under BPM6/ESA 2010; named source for the property-income transition items from GDP to GNI, the same shape as Deutsche Bundesbank's role for Germany and Banca d'Italia's for Italy.

entries.covers: Q2 2026 Balance of Payments (international transactions in goods and services, direct investment, cross-border securities transactions, derivatives)
Q3 2026 Balance of Payments (international transactions in goods and services, direct investment, cross-border securities transactions, derivatives)

release_schedule.note: DNB publishes a running advance release calendar with dated entries for Balance of Payments components; entries found cover Q2 2026 and Q3 2026 releases (quarterly cadence, consistent with releases_per_year=4). Q1 2026 and earlier 2026 entries had already rolled off the calendar by the time of this check (2026-08-11).

reports.title: Statistical Business Register (SBR) / General Business Register
reports.description: Register of legal units, enterprises and enterprise groups maintained by CBS from Chambers of Commerce, tax and other administrative sources; frames the SBS sampling frame and supplies NACE industry coding used in national accounts.

release_schedule.rule: "De cijfers van elk kwartaal worden in de eerste maand van elk kwartaal gepubliceerd" (Figures for each quarter are published in the first month of that quarter) — stated on CBS StatLine pages for business-register-derived tables (e.g. 'Bedrijven; bedrijfstak', 'Bedrijven; bedrijfsgrootte en rechtsvorm'), consistent with the CBS research description for 'Bedrijvendemografie' and 'Populatie van actieve bedrijven in Nederland', both of which state a quarterly ('eenmaal per kwartaal') publication frequency for business-register-based statistics.
release_schedule.note: CBS's 'General Business Register' (ABR) page itself has no dated release calendar; I could not confirm the exact frequency of internal register updates versus the published statistics derived from it. The evidence found consistently points to a quarterly publication cycle (data published in the first month of each quarter) for statistics based on the business register, not monthly as currently on file. Q3 2026 figures were already published July 15, 2026 (first month of Q3), so the next release is Q4 2026 figures in October 2026. Could not verify with a dedicated English-language 'statistical programme' page since the corpus's original URL now 404s.

reports.title: National accounts (ESA 2010)
reports.description: Polish national accounts, compiled under ESA 2010. Documentation is thinner than the German/Dutch/Italian set — no public GNI Inventory at comparable granularity was found, a result later shown NOT to be a general newer-member pattern once Czechia and Croatia (also 2004/2013 accessions) came back as granular as the strongest-documented members.

entries.covers: First annual GDP estimate for 2025 (based on annual statistical reports and final general government data)
First preliminary annual GDP estimate for 2026
Second preliminary annual GDP estimate for 2026
Third preliminary annual GDP estimate for 2026 / Final annual GDP estimate for 2025

release_schedule.rule: Annual GDP data are disseminated multiple times per year as revised data becomes available: first preliminary annual GDP for year t-1, available at the end of January of year t; second preliminary estimate in February; third preliminary estimate in April; first annual GDP estimate for year t-1 (based on annual statistical reports and final general government data) in October; final annual GDP estimate for year t-2 (based on annual reports and administrative sources) in April of the following year.
release_schedule.note: This is the Eurostat ESMS metadata page (section 8/9) for GUS's annual GDP/national accounts data under ESA 2010. No dated GUS release-calendar page with exact days was found via search in this session; exact publication days are announced separately on stat.gov.pl's release calendar and Editorial Title-Plan, but the month-level rule above is stable and matches the on-file releases_per_year=4 (Jan/Feb/April/October each calendar year).
